## Problem and change / 问题与改动

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation / 验证

List the commands actually run and their results. Mark anything not run.
For runtime changes, distinguish CPU protocol checks from real-model GPU checks.
For performance changes, link comparable raw before/after samples and correctness results.

## Generated code / 生成代码

If applicable: generator/model, starting code, budget, and how the result was reviewed.

## User impact / 使用影响

Note any changed commands, API behavior, model limits, or documentation. Omit sections that do not apply.
